title: Watering can with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='100' height='100'>
  <!-- Body of watering can -->
  <rect x="25" y="40" width="45" height="42" rx="8" ry="8" fill="#4CAF50" stroke="#81C784" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- Highlight on body -->
  <rect x="30" y="45" width="12" height="22" rx="5" fill="#81C784" opacity="0.5"/>
  <!-- Top/neck of can -->
  <rect x="30" y="30" width="35" height="14" rx="5" ry="5" fill="#66BB6A" stroke="#A5D6A7" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- Spout -->
  <path d="M68 48 L88 32 L92 38 L72 54 Z" fill="#43A047" stroke="#81C784" stroke-width="2" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <!-- Spout rose (shower head) -->
  <ellipse cx="90" cy="35" rx="8" ry="5" fill="#2E7D32" stroke="#66BB6A" stroke-width="1.5" transform="rotate(-35 90 35)"/>
  <!-- Holes on rose -->
  <circle cx="88" cy="33" r="1" fill="#A5D6A7"/>
  <circle cx="91" cy="34" r="1" fill="#A5D6A7"/>
  <circle cx="89" cy="36" r="1" fill="#A5D6A7"/>
  <circle cx="92" cy="37" r="1" fill="#A5D6A7"/>
  <!-- Handle -->
  <path d="M30 48 Q12 40 15 25 Q18 12 32 18 L35 25" fill="none" stroke="#388E3C" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M30 48 Q14 41 16 27 Q19 15 31 20" fill="none" stroke="#66BB6A" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Face - eyes -->
  <ellipse cx="40" cy="55" rx="5" ry="6" fill="#FFF9C4"/>
  <ellipse cx="58" cy="55" rx="5" ry="6" fill="#FFF9C4"/>
  <!-- Pupils -->
  <circle cx="41" cy="56" r="2.5" fill="#1B5E20"/>
  <circle cx="59" cy="56" r="2.5" fill="#1B5E20"/>
  <!-- Eye highlights -->
  <circle cx="42" cy="54" r="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="60" cy="54" r="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d="M38 66 Q49 76 60 66" fill="none" stroke="#1B5E20" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Cheeks -->
  <circle cx="32" cy="63" r="4" fill="#EF9A9A" opacity="0.6"/>
  <circle cx="66" cy="63" r="4" fill="#EF9A9A" opacity="0.6"/>
  <!-- Water drops from spout -->
  <circle cx="93" cy="42" r="2" fill="#4FC3F7"/>
  <circle cx="96" cy="48" r="2.5" fill="#4FC3F7"/>
  <circle cx="91" cy="49" r="1.5" fill="#81D4FA"/>
  <circle cx="95" cy="54" r="2" fill="#29B6F6"/>
  <circle cx="89" cy="55" r="1.5" fill="#81D4FA"/>
  <!-- Bottom rim -->
  <rect x="25" y="78" width="45" height="5" rx="2" fill="#2E7D32"/>
</svg>
